macros.name: bd
macros.doc: In mathematics it bolds by thickening the glyph in place, so it keeps whatever shape it already has and works on any symbol, not just Latin letters: x is the italic x made heavy, π a bold π, Γ a bold upright Γ. One command covers \bd{a heading} and $\bd{\alpha}$ alike.

macros.name: concretebold
macros.doc: Switch stroking on/off for the text that follows, within the current group.

macros.name: concretenobold
macros.doc: Switch stroking on/off for the text that follows, within the current group.
